ns2:course.label: The College Student
ns2:course.description: Study of the characteristics and development of college students, the institutional contexts in which they operate, and the interaction of students with the college environment.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Special Education, Curriculum and Instruction, Educational Psychology, Educational Policy Studies, Ed Organization and Leadership, or Educ Policy, Orgzn & Leadrshp department.
